provisional_claims.summary: Care plans never advanced: run_plans mutated a stale plan entry after tend_many replaced world.workbench, so repeating plans stayed pending at their first day and one-shot plans never became done. Re-fetch the entry after tend_many. Also execute() now rejects commands with keys other than op/args (and requires op), per "Command accepts only op and args".
provisional_claims.reproduction: create(1); schedule water day 2 repeat 2 runs 2; step 5 -> plan remained pending day 2 remaining 2; now day 4 remaining 0 done. execute(w,{'op':'prune','args':{},'x':1}) previously accepted.

provisional_claims.summary: history.py: (1) checkpoint cache keyed only on last event, so a corrected history reused stale cached state for later events — key on full prefix; (2) resolved references used the originally bound numeric id instead of the logical entity's current id, so after corrections a reference pointed at an unrelated object; (3) cherry-pick deduplicated by command content, merging independently authored identical actions — identity is the event id; (4) rebase order check ignored local branch order (contradictory orders not detected); (5) rebase used parent's current head instead of the fork's recorded base_revision; (6) correction replacements resolved numeric IDs against the final garden rather than the garden at that point in history.
provisional_claims.reproduction: create history; append note A, note B, edit_note ident=B's id; correct removing note A -> edit hits wrong note / stale cached result (verify mismatch). Fork, append on parent, rebase child: base taken from moved parent head drops/duplicates events.

provisional_claims.summary: More fixes: nursery watering restores 3-day supply, dry days halt development, ready batches still gain vigor on hydrated days, planting out always uses 4 nutrients; notes search inclusive end + exact tag match; specimens keep vitality; complete_task honors done=false; overdue excludes today; tasks sorted by due; census vitality averaged over living, natural-log diversity; suitability uses effective shade; recommend empty_only; transect Bresenham tie; forecast includes final day; experiments: events applied once at exact offset, case-insensitive names, against_control = treatment minus control; import_csv double revision; blueprint mirror/turn off-by-one; to_dict journal independent; shade map uses effective shade; history chart x axis uses actual dates; server: publish saves before swap, undo stack keeps newest 30, redo cleared on new edit, stale revision !=, legacy import keeps revision, undo fresh revision; CLI exit code 2.
provisional_claims.reproduction: e.g. forecast(days=10,every=3) lacked day 10 sample; experiment event offset 1 re-applied every day; complete_task(done=False) set True; transform_blueprint mirror produced x==width.

provisional_claims.summary: Server/CLI fixes: publish() with --file recorded the new garden (not the previous) on the undo stack, kept the oldest 30 instead of newest, and never cleared redo on a new edit; revision check only rejected lower revisions (now any mismatch or non-int/bool is 409); legacy import without revision now keeps imported save's revision (was keyed on "world"); undo/redo results get a fresh revision (current+1) instead of stored+1; CLI errors exit code 2. Also forecast no longer duplicates the final sample when days % every != 0; experiments always include the final observation.
provisional_claims.reproduction: forecast(w,10,3) timeline days had 10 twice; experiment(days=7,every=2) lacked offset 7; serve with --file, edit then undo -> restored the edited garden; POST with revision higher than current accepted; `mosslight inspect missing.json` exited 1.

provisional_claims.summary: Campaigns: (1) runtime.execution_version always returned conservation-2, ignoring the campaign's recorded release (classic-1 campaigns ran conservation rain barrels); (2) publish accepted stale workers (generation = ? OR owner != ?) — must match both generation and owner; (3) publish committed branch state before writing its checkpoint in a separate transaction (non-atomic progress); (4) compact deleted checkpoints that are lineage origins of existing forks (protected set unused); (5) fork re-applied treatment events at the checkpoint offset which were already part of the starting garden.
provisional_claims.reproduction: create classic-1 campaign with rain barrel: results equal conservation-2. fork at offset 3 then compact --every 5 -> provenance of the fork failed 'Checkpoint is unavailable'. Fork at offset 1 of 'Extra water' repeated the offset-1 watering.

provisional_claims.summary: Courier CRDT fixes: precedes() iterated the wrong clock's peers (heads/supersession wrong); events now carry per-record causal context (record_clock) so sharing one observation doesn't imply seeing others; _covered used max over all records' contexts instead of the event's record; merge rejected only record mismatches on reused event ids (now any content difference); merged packet counter advanced past its own writer's events; observations hid notes on concurrent edit+delete (now visible if any alive head) and casefolded distinct values (text case lost); project() leaked other records' contexts/clock (could drop unselected observations when merged into a full notebook); acknowledged() used max instead of min across peers (missing ack = 0); put() stored caller-owned values by reference; from_garden default notebook hashed the whole save (copies diverged after any edit) — now uses stable garden identity.
provisional_claims.reproduction: a=new_packet('desk'); put(a,'n',{'text':'Hello'}); b=merge(new_packet('field'),a); put(b,'n',{'text':'hello'}); put(a,'n',{'text':'World'}); observations(merge(a,b)) previously collapsed/wrongly ordered; remove(a,'n') concurrent with b's edit hid note; acknowledged({'x':{'desk':3}},['x','y']) returned 3 not 0.

provisional_claims.summary: Courier CRDT fixes: precedes iterated wrong clock keys; observation values collapsed case (casefold); concurrent edit+delete hid record; merge coverage used union of all record contexts instead of the event's record; event identity reuse check only compared record; merged counter could reuse dots; project leaked contexts/clock of unselected records (dropping recipient's observations / implying unseen edits); acknowledged used max instead of min; put stored caller-owned values by reference; default notebook name hashed full save so copies diverged.
provisional_claims.reproduction: Concurrent put 'hi' vs 'HI' showed one value; checkpoint+project(['n1']) merged into full packet deleted n2; acknowledged({'a':{'x':3}},['a','b']) returned 3 instead of 0.

provisional_claims.summary: Studies/ensembles: (1) studies stage decision finalized as soon as any source had a complete cohort instead of waiting for all trials to be terminal (worker order decided promotion); (2) later study stages started every treatment from the control's checkpoint, discarding earlier treatment care; (3) ensemble_reports paired controls with treatment rows by position (zip of controls.values()) instead of by replicate label, misaligning pairs when a trial is excluded; (4) ensemble cache hit copied the cached origin's identity so equal-save sources were reported under another label; (5) ensemble report() recomputed result from current outcomes instead of returning the published envelope (reports changed after edits); (6) ensemble publish validated stale known_reads instead of the reads actually used, accepting results computed from superseded inputs.
provisional_claims.reproduction: Ensemble with two identical source saves: second reported with first's replicate label. Edit plan after report rev0 -> report --revision 0 changes. Study with 2 stages: stage-1 treatment jobs' initial state digest equals control's.

provisional_claims.summary: save_merge: all records were keyed as base identities, so independently created notes/tasks with the same id on both replicas collided (conflict or merged). Now non-inherited ids are keyed by replica origin and reallocated.
provisional_claims.reproduction: base=create(1); add_note(left,'left'); add_note(right,'right'); reconcile(...) -> previously conflict on /records/notes/["base",1]; now ready with two notes.

provisional_claims.summary: Irrigation: (1) allocate() never used residual reverse arcs (skipped pipe None edges), so it was greedy, not maximal — deliveries could fall short of what capacities permit; (2) solve() deduplicated states by aggregate census instead of full world state, discarding distinct gardens and returning suboptimal schedules. Field calibration: estimate() computed least-squares sums on raw timestamps (catastrophic cancellation for large/epoch timestamps with fractional seconds); now mean-centred.
provisional_claims.reproduction: allocate([s->a 1, a->b 1, s->c 1, c->a 1, a->d 1], 's', {'b':1,'d':1}, 10) could deliver 1 if DFS routed s->a->b then no augmenting reverse path; estimate on timestamps ~1.7e9 with ms spacing returned garbage slope.

provisional_claims.summary: Campaigns always executed with conservation-2 (runtime.execution_version ignored the recorded release), so classic-1 campaigns ran the wrong ecology; now uses the definition's runtime id. Also plain experiments omitted the final observation when days % every != 0.
provisional_claims.reproduction: Create campaign --version classic-1 with rain barrel treatment: results matched conservation-2. experiment(world,7,t,every=2) samples lacked offset 7.

provisional_claims.summary: Workspace catalog: upgrading a format-1 catalog reindexed the label index with the old (casefold-only) key function and only then installed the NFKC/whitespace key, leaving a stale expression index so searches for legacy receipts with spacing/fullwidth differences failed. Install the new key before REINDEX. Import also tolerates format-1 receipts without locator and validates ids.
provisional_claims.reproduction: Create v1 catalog DB with receipt label 'Field  Pond' and index built with casefold key; open WorkspaceCatalog; search('field pond') returned [] before fix, now returns the receipt.

provisional_claims.summary: Courier: after merging a projected packet (whose clock covers other records' counters), checkpoint() stamped every record's context with the whole packet clock and new edits used the packet clock as context, so edits/deletions of other observations the recipient never saw were treated as superseded and dropped on the next merge. Contexts are now per-record (record_clock) for both new events and checkpoints. Also recover() rejects non-string slips with the clear damaged-slip error.
provisional_claims.reproduction: A: put r2 text; B=merge(new_packet('B'),A); A: put r2 tags, put r1; B=checkpoint(merge(B,project(A,['r1']))); observations(merge(B,A)) lost r2's tags.

provisional_claims.summary: history_exchange reconcile: _common_bases truncated the set of maximal common ancestors to one (maximal[:1]). In criss-cross collaboration (both collaborators reconciled the same work, then continued), the merge base became an arbitrary single parent, so a later correction/reversion (removed event) was resurrected depending on hash order. Now all maximal common ancestors are returned and recursively merged into a virtual base by comparison().
provisional_claims.reproduction: Genesis with note; desk publishes D1 (edit_note), field publishes F1 (task); both reconcile(D1,F1) independently -> M1, M2. Desk corrects M1 removing its edit event and publishes D2; field appends a note to M2 and publishes F2. desk.reconcile(D2,F2): before fix sometimes note text 'desk edit' reappears (reversion lost); after fix always 'base'.

provisional_claims.summary: field_calibration.estimate: readings sharing a timestamp were each weighted separately in the least-squares fit instead of being averaged first (docs: "When observations share a timestamp, their average is used"), skewing the trend.
